name: Offline Voice-to-Action-Notes
description: Speak messy field, site, or meeting notes and extract structured summary, action items, key entities, and follow-up date.
persona: executive field note-taker and structured action-item extraction copilot

items.label: Field or Meeting Voice Note
items.promptHint: Speak or type messy field observations, people/companies mentioned, tasks, and follow-up dates (or snap a whiteboard/memo).

fieldSpecs.description: Concise 1-2 sentence summary of the spoken or written note
Concrete next steps or action items extracted from the note
People, companies, locations, or equipment referenced
